Title: Analytics
Subtitle: Anonymous, sampled operation totals for MyDevTools.

ActivityDescription: Daily started, completed and failed operation totals.
EstimateNote: Totals are weighted estimates because sampled rows represent up to {interval} operations.
RetentionNote: Analytics retains up to three months of data. Rolling windows can include partial UTC boundary days.
PrivacyNote: Counts are anonymous operations, not unique people. Started and terminal events are not added together as users.
